title: OpenDeception: Benchmarking and Investigating AI Deceptive Behaviors via Open-ended Simulation
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (OpenDeception) specifically for evaluating deceptive behaviors and intentions in AI agents. Deception is a primary concern in AI ethics and moral alignment. The benchmark scenarios, such as telecommunications fraud, emotional manipulation, and inciting hatred, represent direct evaluations of an agent's moral and ethical transgressions.
